\emph{Use $\mathbf{u}=\left\langle 2,4,1\right\rangle $ and $\mathbf{v}=\left\langle 1,-3,2\right\rangle $

\item \label{enu:vect-start}$\mathbf{u}-2\mathbf{v}$\vfill
\item $\mathbf{u\cdot}\mathbf{v}$\vfill
\item \label{enu:vect-end}$\mathbf{u\times v}$\vfill\vspace{1cm}
\end{enumerate}

\emph{Use the vectors $\mathbf{u}=\left\langle 3,6\right\rangle $,
$\mathbf{v}=\left\langle 2,3\right\rangle $ and the point $P(1,-4)$
to complete problems \ref{enu:pts_and_vects-start}--\ref{enu:pts_and_vects-end}.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item \label{enu:pts_and_vects-start}Find the line through $P$ and parallel
to $\mathbf{u}$.
\item Find the angle between $\mathbf{u}$ and $\mathbf{v}$.
\item \label{enu:Find-a-vector}Find a vector orthogonal to $\mathbf{u}$
and $\mathbf{v}$.
\item \label{enu:pts_and_vects-end}Is the vector found in problem \ref{enu:Find-a-vector}
unique? If not find another vector orthogonal to $\mathbf{u}$ and
$\mathbf{v}$.
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Let $\mathbf{r}(t)=\left\langle 1,\frac{2}{t^{2}},e^{-t}\right\rangle $.
Evaluate problems \ref{enu:calc}--\ref{clac-end}.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item \label{enu:calc}$\mathbf{r}'(t)$
\item ${\displaystyle \int}\mathbf{r}(t)\,dt$ 
\item ${\displaystyle \int}_{0}^{1}\mathbf{r}(t)\,dt$
\item \label{clac-end}${\displaystyle \lim_{t\rightarrow\infty}\mathbf{r}(t)}$
\end{enumerate}
\emph{Compute the slope of the tangent line of the vector valued function
at $t=1$.}
\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item $\mathbf{r}(t)=\left\langle 1+t^{3},2\sin3t,e^{t}\right\rangle $\vfill
\end{enumerate}

\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item A bullet is fired with a muzzle velocity of 1037 ft/sec from a gun
aimed at an angle of $8\textdegree$ above the horizontal. Find a
vector describing the vertical and horizontal components of the bullet's
velocity.\vfill
\item A sailboat floats in a current that flows due west at 3 m/s. The wind
is blowing $30\textdegree$ north of east at a speed of 5 m/s. Find
the speed of the boat relative to the shore.\vfill
\item How much work does it take to slide a box 30 meters along the ground
by pulling it with 200 Newtons of force at an angle of $15\textdegree$
from the horizontal?\vfill
\item A woman does legs lifts with a 10 lb weight attached to her foot (so
the force is directed downward). The distance from her foot to her
knee is 2 ft, and her leg below the knee makes an angle of $\theta$
to the vertical. 

\begin{enumerate}[resume]
\item Find the magnitude of the torque on her knee if she holds her leg
at $45\textdegree$.\vfill
\item What positions minimizes and maximize the magnitude of the torque?\vspace{1.75cm}
\end{enumerate}
\end{enumerate}
